params.name: balanceAsOf
params.description: A query option to return historical balance information from a certain date. Balance information includes opening and closed ledger balances, opening and closing available balances, and commercial balances. The date must be within 180 days of the current date. If a date is not provided, historical balance information is not returned. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date to search a past date range. Leave blank to search prior day transactions. If you enter a date, you must also specify an end date. Start date can not be older than 180 days from today. If no date range is provided, the request returns the prior weekday's information. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for a date range. Leave blank to search prior day transactions. If you enter a date, you must also specify a start date. The end date cannot be today's date. To search for a single day's transactions, make the end date the same as the start date. If no date range is provided, the request returns the prior weekday's information. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
